I am a woman farming here in Dowa, and maize is what feeds my family. This year I was able to get a FISP coupon, so I will put the subsidized fertilizer on my maize plot — one bag of NPK at planting and one bag of urea for topdressing, spread over the 0.35 ha. I also carry manure from the kraal to the field because the soil is getting tired, and I try to use the hybrid seed that came with the coupon since it yields better than the local seed I saved. I weed with my own hands and my children help, but for ridging before the rains I sometimes pay a few young men ganyu because my back cannot do it all alone.
